verdict.headline: Lagide: best available to check
verdict.reason: Best available for checking; location, geometry, tide or condition uncertainty prevents a confident go recommendation.

conversationalSummary.text: For TODAY I’d treat Lagide as the best place to check, but it’s still a bit marginal. Surfline’s consistency is lully and the wave power looks a little soft on the rocky shelf at mid tide, so it could end up sectiony rather than flowing—especially if conditions don’t look sharper on the cams. I’d check Surfline and the MEO Beachcam around lunch (13:00) first, and only commit if the faces look noticeably cleaner than expected. Recommendation: check first.
